card.name: Hedging words before adverse event descriptions
card.fires_on: Qualifying words such as suggestive, attributed, described, consistent, appeared, evidence and potentially, placed right before an adverse event or cause is stated in clinical trial results.

modes.label: Attribution verbs
modes.description: Verbs that link events to a cause or description, such as attributed, described or appeared.
modes.example: 28 of 41 deaths in the epoetin alfa arm and 13 of 16 deaths in the placebo arm were<< attributed>> to disease progression.

modes.label: Hedging adjectives
modes.description: Words like suggestive, consistent, potentially or evidence that soften a finding before naming it.
